sentences.en: The instinct for survival is inherent in every living thing.
sentences.zh: 生存本能存在于每一种生物中。

sentences.en: This medicine will increase the survival rate of the patients.
sentences.zh: 这种药物将提高患者的存活率。

sentences.en: The company does not have a good chance of survival.
sentences.zh: 这家公司存活的机会不大。

senses.zh: 幸存，生存 - 残存的人[物]；遗物；遗风
